assumptions.statement: Official three-level and key-area polygons are missing; repository provisional polygons are used only for generation and intake review.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and figures require replacement and recomputation when official files arrive.

assumptions.statement: Project-specific FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks and control lines are missing.
assumptions.impact: All intensity and form guidance remains qualitative and subject to professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines, sections, rail integration and traffic counts are missing.
assumptions.impact: Mobility lines are conceptual connectivity diagrams, not engineering alignments.

assumptions.statement: Parcel, ownership and implementation boundaries are missing.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level acquisition, demolition or delivery claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, heights, uses, ages and condition surveys are missing.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are typology envelopes; retain/retrofit/replace decisions require survey.

assumptions.statement: Heritage-protection boundaries and construction-control zones are missing.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks and public-space interventions must remain reversible and outside protected zones after review.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, fire safety, drainage, flood and energy-capacity data are missing.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure proposals are service architectures, not capacity or relocation conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Public-service facility inventory and capacity are missing.
assumptions.impact: Service proposals describe access patterns and prototypes, not confirmed capacity.

assumptions.statement: Global cases are background references from primary public pages.
assumptions.impact: Only mechanisms are transferred; case metrics and governance conditions are not treated as Haidian facts.
